key_provisions_or_claims: Trading robots cannot guarantee profits; long-term forex success requires human supervision.
Public should be educated about risks of trading robots.
Vendors should include disclaimers about uncertain future conditions.
Investors should check success/failure rates and choose between domestic and foreign brokers.
Analyses the topic through strategic intelligence and World System Theory.
annotation.summary_en: Indonesian journal article on forex trading robots (software) viewed through strategic intelligence and World System Theory. It warns that trading robots guarantee no profit, need human supervision, and that users and vendors should be informed of risks and disclaimers. Not about physical robots.
